title: Shopify source of truth
behavior: Orders, payment records, refunds and inventory changes pass through the supplied Shopify-shaped mock.
evidence: Sale and refund integration tests; source order in bill details.
limit: No live Shopify credentials or production API integration.

title: Confirmation in under 10 seconds
behavior: Customer, catalog and prescription data are loaded before confirmation. Successful completion durations and p95 are recorded.
evidence: Live timings above; duplicate and uncertainty tests.
limit: Local mock measurements do not establish a seven-store production SLA.

title: Offers with explainable stacking
behavior: Configured stackable offers combine; incompatible offers are explained. Every discount is allocated to lines in paise.
evidence: Offer tests; Why these offers? in the bill panel.
limit: Uses the exercise's offer definitions. Unconditional three-offer stacking requires stakeholder agreement.

title: Priority and campaign flags
behavior: Customer tags are displayed next to their identity before products are selected.
evidence: Load Karthik Reddy in the guided demo.
limit: Queue-tool parity is represented by supplied tags, not a live queue integration.

title: Manager discount with identity and reason
behavior: Authenticated managers can request at most 10%; reason and staff identity are recorded on the order. Cashiers cannot bypass the role check.
evidence: Authorization tests; manager discount form and order note attributes.

title: One family bill, distinct prescriptions
behavior: Each wearer has a phone, selected items and independently validated prescription. All pairs create one order and one invoice.
evidence: Family acceptance test; add three wearers to one bill.

title: Daily sales by channel and store
behavior: Walk-in, WhatsApp and online-pickup attribution appears in Shopify notes and store reports.
evidence: Channel report acceptance test.
limit: Online pickup is a channel label, not fulfillment of an existing web order.

title: Cash expenses and drawer reconciliation
behavior: Open float, reasoned expenses, cash sales/refunds and manager close produce expected cash and signed variance.
evidence: Cash roundtrip acceptance test; Cash drawer screen.

title: Finance notified above ₹200 variance
behavior: An absolute variance strictly greater than ₹200 queues one finance email immediately at close.
evidence: Variance threshold and outbox tests.
limit: Preview only until SMTP and finance recipient are configured.

title: Prescription-compatible lenses
behavior: Sphere, cylinder, ADD, validity and lens metadata are validated for every wearer before payment.
evidence: Clinical validation tests and incompatible-lens acceptance test.

title: 5-degree manual axis entry
behavior: Clinician-only prescription entry offers 5–180° in five-degree steps. The API rejects non-grid manual entries.
evidence: Clinical role and axis API tests.
limit: Existing externally issued prescriptions are preserved unchanged.

title: Lens-only remakes and cost ownership
behavior: Manager creates a remake linked to the original bill, choosing customer, Eluno or external optometrist as cost owner. No frame line is created.
evidence: Remake zero-charge and unchanged-frame-stock test.
limit: External cost recovery is recorded, not automatically collected. Customer price uses catalog/offer rules.

title: Effective-dated HSN GST and inclusive MRP
behavior: Invoice lines expose MRP, discount, taxable value, CGST and SGST with exact paise reconciliation.
evidence: Tax unit tests; printable invoice; sunglasses sale test.
limit: Exercise tax configuration is not a claim of current legal compliance.

title: Sequential invoice register with cancellations
behavior: Store-specific serialized allocation retains reserved, issued and cancelled invoice numbers without reuse.
evidence: Persistence tests; cancellation/register acceptance test.

title: Refund, tax reversal and linked credit note
behavior: A full refund is recorded in Shopify and has a printable credit note referencing the original invoice.
evidence: Full refund tests; Credit note action on a refunded bill.
limit: Full refunds only. Documents use synthetic data and need finance sign-off for real issuance.

title: Return frames to the billing store; scrap lenses
behavior: Full refunds restock physical frames at the original location and never restock made-to-order lenses.
evidence: Integration tests assert before/after inventory and refund line restock flags.

title: Saved bills and guarded outage recovery
behavior: Browser/server drafts, persisted state machines and read-only reconciliation prevent blind payment retries. Durable mock snapshots survive restarts.
evidence: Lost-response tests; snapshot roundtrip test; inspect pending bills.
limit: Unknown terminal responses require manual investigation. Crash-point automation and true offline charging are not provided.

title: Store day-end source reconciliation
behavior: IST order-day sales, channel totals and refund-event-day collection totals are computed from Shopify records; payment delta is visible.
evidence: Report/date-boundary tests and report screen.
limit: Mock API is bounded to fewer than 250 orders; live pagination and settlement integration remain.

title: Founder report every morning at 10am
behavior: A persistent outbox queues yesterday's bills, average bill and discounts by store at 10:00 Asia/Kolkata, with catch-up after startup.
evidence: Idempotent digest test and report outbox.
limit: App must be running; actual delivery requires configured SMTP and recipient.

title: Actual login and enforced permissions
behavior: Salted password hashes, expiring revocable sessions, CSRF checks, role enforcement, store boundaries and login throttling protect APIs.
evidence: Authorization, session and CSRF acceptance tests.
limit: Demo accounts are provisioned by CLI; production SSO, user lifecycle and security review remain.

title: Seven-store rollout by 15 November
behavior: All seven seeded stores can be demonstrated. Container and CI files support deployment and review.
evidence: Store selector and all-store reporting.
limit: Real deployment, device testing, sign-off and pilot operations are separate acceptance gates.

title: Remove queue beverage question
behavior: Tracked as a separate queue-tool change; not silently marked complete.
evidence: Stakeholder reply and scope decisions.
limit: The queue-tool code and service are not supplied.

title: Repair Indiranagar footfall camera
behavior: Tracked as a separate hardware/vendor incident.
evidence: Stakeholder reply and scope decisions.
limit: No camera access or diagnostic data is available.
